schema.text: How do traffic levels and vehicle speeds on your cycling route typically affect your journey?

options.text: Not at all — traffic does not affect my cycling experience
Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rarely affects my comfort or route
Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces my comfort or enjoyment while cycling
Significantly — traffic often makes me feel stressed or unsafe
Very significantly — I change my route or travel time specifically to avoid heavy or fast traffic

en.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: How do traffic levels and vehicle speeds on your cycling route typically affect your journey?
en.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Not at all — traffic does not affect my cycling experience
en.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rarely affects my comfort or route
en.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces my comfort or enjoyment while cycling
en.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Significantly — traffic often makes me feel stressed or unsafe
en.#Very significantly — I change my route: Very significantly — I change my route or travel time specifically to avoid heavy or fast traffic

it.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: In che modo il livello di traffico e la velocità dei veicoli lungo il tuo percorso ciclabile influenzano normalmente il tuo viaggio?
it.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Per niente — il traffico non influisce sulla mia esperienza in bicicletta
it.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Poco — noto il traffico, ma raramente influisce sul mio comfort o sul percorso
it.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Moderatamente — il traffico a volte riduce il mio comfort o il piacere di pedalare
it.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Molto — il traffico mi fa spesso sentire stressato/a o in pericolo
it.#Very significantly — I change my route: Moltissimo — cambio percorso o orario di viaggio appositamente per evitare traffico intenso o veloce

fr.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: Comment le niveau de trafic et la vitesse des véhicules sur votre itinéraire à vélo influencent-ils généralement votre trajet ?
fr.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Pas du tout — le trafic n’a pas d’effet sur mon expérience à vélo
fr.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Un peu — je remarque le trafic, mais il change rarement mon confort ou mon itinéraire
fr.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Modérément — le trafic réduit parfois mon confort ou le plaisir de faire du vélo
fr.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Beaucoup — le trafic me fait souvent sentir stressé(e) ou en danger
fr.#Very significantly — I change my route: Énormément — je change mon itinéraire ou mon heure de déplacement pour éviter un trafic dense ou rapide

de.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: Wie beeinflussen Verkehrsmenge und Geschwindigkeit der Fahrzeuge auf Ihrer Radstrecke normalerweise Ihre Fahrt?
de.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Gar nicht — der Verkehr beeinflusst mein Radfahren nicht
de.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Etwas — ich bemerke den Verkehr, aber er beeinflusst Komfort oder Route nur selten
de.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Mäßig — der Verkehr macht das Radfahren manchmal weniger angenehm
de.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Stark — der Verkehr führt oft dazu, dass ich mich gestresst oder unsicher fühle
de.#Very significantly — I change my route: Sehr stark — ich ändere gezielt Route oder Fahrzeit, um starken oder schnellen Verkehr zu vermeiden

tr.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: Bisiklet güzergâhınızdaki trafik yoğunluğu ve araç hızları yolculuğunuzu genellikle nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Hiç etkilemez — trafik bisiklet deneyimimi etkilemez
tr.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Biraz — trafiği fark ederim ama konforumu veya güzergâhımı nadiren etkiler
tr.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Orta düzeyde — trafik bazen bisiklet sürerken konforumu veya keyfimi azaltır
tr.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Çok — trafik sık sık stresli veya güvensiz hissetmeme neden olur
tr.#Very significantly — I change my route: Çok fazla — yoğun veya hızlı trafikten kaçınmak için güzergâhımı veya yolculuk saatimi değiştiririm

fa.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: حجم ترافیک و سرعت خودروها در مسیر دوچرخه‌سواری معمولاً چه اثری بر سفر شما دارد؟
fa.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: اصلاً — ترافیک بر تجربه دوچرخه‌سواری من اثر ندارد
fa.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: کمی — ترافیک را می‌بینم، اما به ندرت بر راحتی یا مسیرم اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: تا حد متوسط — ترافیک گاهی راحتی یا لذت دوچرخه‌سواری را کم می‌کند
fa.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: زیاد — ترافیک اغلب باعث می‌شود احساس استرس یا ناامنی کنم
fa.#Very significantly — I change my route: خیلی زیاد — برای دوری از ترافیک سنگین یا سریع، مسیر یا زمان سفر را تغییر می‌دهم

hu.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: Hogyan befolyásolja általában a forgalom nagysága és a járművek sebessége a kerékpáros útvonalán az utazását?
hu.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: Egyáltalán nem — a forgalom nem befolyásolja a kerékpározási élményemet
hu.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: Kissé — észreveszem a forgalmat, de ritkán befolyásolja a kényelmemet vagy az útvonalamat
hu.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: Közepesen — a forgalom néha csökkenti a kerékpározás kényelmét vagy élvezetét
hu.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: Jelentősen — a forgalom gyakran stresszessé vagy bizonytalanná tesz
hu.#Very significantly — I change my route: Nagyon jelentősen — kifejezetten módosítom az útvonalat vagy az indulási időt, hogy elkerüljem a sűrű vagy gyors forgalmat

ar.#How do traffic levels and vehicle speed: كيف يؤثر حجم حركة المرور وسرعة المركبات على طريقك بالدراجة في رحلتك عادةً؟
ar.#Not at all — traffic does not affect my: لا يؤثر إطلاقًا — حركة المرور لا تؤثر في تجربتي بالدراجة
ar.#Slightly — I notice traffic, but it rar: تؤثر قليلًا — ألاحظ حركة المرور لكنها نادرًا ما تؤثر في راحتي أو طريقي
ar.#Moderately — traffic sometimes reduces: تؤثر بدرجة متوسطة — حركة المرور تقلل أحيانًا من راحتي أو استمتاعي بالدراجة
ar.#Significantly — traffic often makes me: تؤثر كثيرًا — حركة المرور تجعلني أشعر بالتوتر أو عدم الأمان غالبًا
ar.#Very significantly — I change my route: تؤثر كثيرًا جدًا — أغيّر الطريق أو وقت الرحلة خصيصًا لتجنب حركة المرور الكثيفة أو السريعة
